descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Retro Inspired. Future Forward.
Inspired by the **arcade classic Pop-A-Shot, JUST HOOPS** brings arcade basketball to mixed reality. Play through more than **60 levels** of changing hoops, take on unique challenges, create your own trick shots, or compete with other players.

[media]

# Your Hands. Your Shot.
Play basketball naturally with **hand tracking** at the heart of the experience. Reach out, grab the ball and shoot with **Natural Shot**, with optional assists to make shooting as accessible or challenging.
[media]

# Point. Shoot. Score.
For an easier, more casual way to play, try **Pointer Shot**. Aim with your hand and shoot with a simple gesture. Intuitive, low effort and easy to jump into.
[media]

# 60+ Levels. Always a New Hoop.
From classic Pop-A-Shot to moving hoops, snakes, space invaders, dinosaurs, rotating targets and more, every level brings something different. Chase high scores and challenges, or switch to **Zen mode** and play without the pressure of a timer.
[media]

# Create Your Own Trick Shots.
Turn your room into a playground with **Trickshots in mixed reality**. Create your own shots using your real environment and share them online for other players to try.
[media]

# Play Together.
Challenge another player in **1v1 matchmaking**, or create a **private room for 2–4 players** and play with friends. Go head-to-head and see who owns the hoop.
[media]

# Your Space. Your Arena.
Play directly in your room in **mixed reality* or step into one of our VR environments. Play with your **bare hands or controllers** your space, your way to play.

# Pull Up. Wherever you are!
